Separate Publish exposes all eight nodes with the exact matching public CSS color.

scope: Browser test and documentation only; no runtime source, production data, database migration, or R2 change. This proves a shared Inspector style route across these partial types, not full per-type acceptance. Full 77.44.7.A remains open.
